learnings: `and`/`or` return one of their *operands*, not necessarily `True`/`False`.
Short-circuiting is observable: a tracer shows the right operand never runs.
Name sub-conditions (`is_staff`) before combining them so access rules stay readable.
pitfalls: Using `print()` as an operand always yields `None`, so the original demo printed the wrong branch.
